title: Chapter 588
text:
Why did Black Star call out to me, and his tone is so weird …

Brock suddenly stood still. He was slightly shocked, and all kinds of guesses flashed through his mind.

Did I give myself away?

That's impossible … Brock took a deep breath and suppressed the uneasiness in his heart. He turned around to face Han Xiao and pretended to be surprised.

"Your Excellency Black Star, is there a problem?"

Han Xiao stared at Brock and sized him up. Then, he looked at the information that popped up on the interface again.

His level was much higher than these freelance mercenaries. The attributes, skills, and specialties of the freelance mercenaries were no secret in front of Han Xiao.

Brock's strength had barely reached Grade B. Most of the freelance mercenaries who applied were Grade C, and there were only a few Grade B. Brock was considered an elite among them, and he was the first Grade B Warrior that Han Xiao had tested.

However, in Brock's profession list, there was a [Dark-star Elite Warrior]. In the skill list, there were also skills that were trained by Dark-star. Han Xiao had been involved with Dark-star for a few years, so he naturally could not have remembered wrongly.

In addition, Brock was a mixed-blood Godora, so this guy's identity was obvious.

This was one of the remaining Dark-star forces, one of the secret personnel who was on the run!

He actually dared to come and join my camp. This guy must have grown ten times the courage …

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. His brain worked quickly, and he instantly guessed Brock's goal of hiding under the light.

He wants to gain my trust, hide in my camp, and be a spy? Is this his own subjective action, or is he under orders?

Han Xiao thought to himself. He thought further. Not long ago, Godora's people had told him bad news. They had lost the Dark-star leader and Ashes. These two guys were nowhere to be found.

The leader of Dark-star was a dangerous figure. Godora had let go of the chief evil, and Han Xiao felt that the Dark-star leader would make a comeback sooner or later. He wondered if Brock had been instructed by the leader of Dark-star. If so, did that mean that the leader of Dark-star had a secret method to contact the remaining forces?

Perhaps he could follow Brock's lead and find the leader of Dark-star!

With a thought, Han Xiao raised an eyebrow and smiled. He said to Brock, "You are very strong. I want to give you a special class. Are you interested?"

Brock heaved a huge sigh of relief. His hanging heart was finally at ease. He immediately felt that his worries were a little unnecessary.

'I'm overthinking things. It's impossible for me to be exposed.'

Brock completely relaxed and pretended to be flattered. "What do you need me to do?"

"Oh, I want you to be the instructor of the training camp for the time being and help me train the mercenaries who have yet to reach the standard."

"Alright, no problem."

Brock hurriedly nodded, secretly happy.

Although an instructor was not considered a cadre and did not have the chance to come into contact with the core, this was a good start. Being given a special position as soon as he joined proved that Black Star valued him. This way, it would be easier to gain Black Star's trust!

"Do your job well. Go to the side and wait for a while. After the test is over, I'll make the arrangements."

Han Xiao encouraged him and sent the excited Brock away. He secretly threw an Observer's Mark at Brock.

The Observer's Mark could locate up to five targets at the same time. He still had one last empty spot left for Brock. In the future, if he wanted to mark a new target, he would need to replace one of the five old targets.

Brock's identity as a spy had been exposed. Not only did Han Xiao not get rid of Brock, but he also wanted to boldly use this person. With Philip and the Observer's Mark, none of Brock's little movements could escape his eyes. Once the other party made any strange movements, he would be able to discover it immediately. Of course, Brock had just joined, so in order to disguise himself, he would definitely not dare to do anything rash.

Most importantly, if a spy wanted to gain his trust, he would definitely work hard without any complaints. This was a very useful coolie. If he did not squeeze him dry, he would feel bad.

Coincidentally, the training camp of Base No.1 had not been built yet. Only Grade B Supers had the ability to become the instructor of a large group of Grade C Supers. Training others was very troublesome. Han Xiao did not want to waste his free time. He had originally planned to call Ginette back, but now that he had Brock, it was enough. Anyway, no matter how he ordered this guy, Han Xiao would not feel bad.

…

This small episode did not cause any abnormalities, but it made many people even more excited.

To them, this meant that Black Star valued talents. As long as they were strong, they would have a chance to get a better position on the spot.

Time passed, and Han Xiao tested them for a few more hours. About five thousand people passed and became official mercenaries. More than a thousand people failed and were sent to the training camp.

During this time, he discovered three more Grade B Supers. Unfortunately, their talents and skills were not outstanding, so they were at the normal level without any bonuses. They were relatively normal Grade B Supers. However, no matter how small a mosquito was, it was still meat. They were Grade B Supers after all. Therefore, Han Xiao promoted the three of them to squad captains on the spot. They had the authority to gather a certain number of Black Star Mercenaries to form a fixed team.

There were two promotion systems in the Black Star Corps. The first was the individual merit system, which was from one star to five stars. The last was the honorary title of 'Black Star Eighteen Horsemen', which was promoted according to the amount of contribution, allowing the individual to enjoy better benefits.

The second was the occupation system, which was the management structure of the army. Han Xiao had learned from the Sky Ring Army. The occupation system and the merit system complemented each other. The higher one's merit level or strength, the higher one's position would be, and they would be able to manage more teams. In other words, they would become a squad captain.

Grade B Supers met the strength requirements and could directly become squad captains. Naturally, no one had any objections.

Currently, the Black Star Corps was divided into a few factions. The Sunil Faction led by Herlous, the War Alliance Faction led by Harmon, the Free Faction led by the players and some mercenaries. This faction had the largest number of people and could be seen as the most normal group of people. There was also the Confidant Faction formed by officers such as Aroshia.

Only Han Xiao could command the people of all these factions. Normally, these factions would do their own things. Among them, the Sunil Faction and the War Alliance Faction were the most obvious. The members were very close to each other and had a strong sense of cohesion.

Where there were people, there would be competition. Forming factions was a problem that would inevitably arise after expansion. As the Black Star Corps expanded, the difficulty of management also increased. If they wanted to develop better, they had to imitate the other large mercenary groups and establish layers of management systems so that everyone had a clear division of labor. This was also a problem that Han Xiao had been thinking about recently.

The upper echelons were a problem.

Currently, all the officers were basically combatants and did not have any specific functions. Only Herlous could barely be considered his assistant. There were many empty positions, such as vice captain, area manager, mercenary manager, logistics manager, spaceship commander, and so on.

These positions were like screw holes, and the elites and officers were the screws. Han Xiao had to find the right screws, put them into the holes, and tighten them. Only then would the management structure of the Black Star Corps become stable.

The army has hundreds of thousands of people. The base troops are huge, but there are very few elites in the upper echelons. The structure of the forces is like a pyramid. Sigh, I need to recruit more high-level combatants.

Han Xiao shook his head. Although his base troops were much stronger than many large mercenaries, high-level combatants were the weakness of the faction. He was the only Calamity Grade in the Black Star Corps, and there were only about ten Grade B elites. Compared to the three Calamity Grade Supers and thousands of Grade B Supers in the Sky Ring Army, he was nothing.

Han Xiao did not lack people with potential under his command. For example, Sylvia was Grade A in his previous life. Herlous seemed to have the potential to reach Grade A as well. Hella and Aurora's Esper Abilities even exceeded Grade A, not to mention the players with huge potential.

However, potential was not strength. These people with potential had not grown up yet, and Fu Ding, who had a protagonist aura and a powerful sister, was not his subordinate but his employer. The players were also limited by the version. At the very least, they would not be able to reach Grade B in Version 2.0.

If only I could get a Calamity Grade to come.

Han Xiao sighed. Expanding the faction came with many problems, and there were too many areas that needed to be improved.

At this time, the last tester came in front of him. Han Xiao patted him, and the other party's attributes popped up on the interface.

With just one look, Han Xiao's expression changed.

Total Level … 135?

This was the freelance mercenary with the highest level among all of them!

He was only seven levels lower than him!

Han Xiao was energized. He looked up and sized up this freelance mercenary named Reynold.

Hmm … this is a Galactic Human with snow-white skin. He seems to be of mixed blood. His face is a little long, and his nose is high. He is not as handsome as me, but he has a special temperament. His personality should be more rational and cold, but his eyes are bright … Wow, this guy is also staring at me.

Han Xiao raised his brows and looked at the other attributes of this person.
